verdict: Yes. Revamp Moto from Nashik pitched utility electric bikes for urban use on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Low-speed e-bikes don't need registration, which makes them easier to build and sell, and delivery workers and commuters use them.
angle: Electric cycles and low-speed e-bikes are popular for short commutes and deliveries. Low-speed models under 25 km/h are exempt from registration. Service and battery quality decide reviews.
